name: aws-bedrock-agent-runtime
title: AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime
description: Invoke Model of AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime service.
label: ai,cloud

properties.name: label
properties.description: Logical name

properties.name: knowledgeBaseId
properties.description: Define the Knowledge Base Id we are going to use

properties.name: modelId
properties.description: Define the model Id we are going to use

properties.name: operation
properties.description: The operation to perform

properties.name: overrideEndpoint
properties.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with the uriEndpointOverride option

properties.name: pojoRequest
properties.description: If we want to use a POJO request as body or not

properties.name: profileCredentialsName
properties.description: If using a profile credentials provider, this parameter will set the profile name

properties.name: region
properties.description: The region in which Bedrock Agent Runtime client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example, ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

properties.name: uriEndpointOverride
properties.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

properties.name: useDefaultCredentialsProvider
properties.description: Set whether the Bedrock Agent Runtime client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

properties.name: useProfileCredentialsProvider
properties.description: Set whether the Bedrock Agent Runtime client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: bedrockAgentRuntimeAsyncClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use an existing configured AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime async client (required for invokeFlow which streams events back).

properties.name: bedrockAgentRuntimeClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use an existing configured AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime client

properties.name: agentAliasId
properties.label: agent
properties.description: The unique identifier of the agent alias to invoke, used by the invokeAgent operation.

properties.name: agentId
properties.label: agent
properties.description: The unique identifier of the agent to invoke, used by the invokeAgent operation.

properties.name: enableTrace
properties.label: flow,agent
properties.description: Enables tracing for the invokeFlow and agent operations. When enabled, the producer collects the trace events and publishes them in the CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowTraces or CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentTraces header.

properties.name: foundationModel
properties.label: agent
properties.description: The foundation model used by the invokeInlineAgent operation.

properties.name: instruction
properties.label: agent
properties.description: The instruction given to the agent defined by the invokeInlineAgent operation.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.label: agent
properties.description: The unique identifier of the agent session. Reuse the same value across invocations to continue the same conversation. When not set, a random session id is generated for each invocation.

properties.name: streamOutputMode
properties.label: agent
properties.description: The streaming output mode (complete or chunks) used by the agent operations. In complete mode the response chunks are accumulated and the body is the full text. In chunks mode the body is the list of chunks.

properties.name: flowAliasIdentifier
properties.label: flow
properties.description: The unique identifier of the Bedrock flow alias to invoke (used by the invokeFlow operation). Can be overridden per exchange via the CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowAliasIdentifier header.

properties.name: flowIdentifier
properties.label: flow
properties.description: The unique identifier of the Bedrock flow to invoke (used by the invokeFlow operation). Can be overridden per exchange via the CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowIdentifier header.

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the Bedrock Agent Runtime client

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy port when instantiating the Bedrock Agent Runtime client

properties.name: proxyProtocol
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the Bedrock Agent Runtime client

properties.name: accessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Access Key

properties.name: secretKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Secret Key

properties.name: sessionToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role

properties.name: trustAllCertificates
properties.label: security
properties.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

properties.name: useSessionCredentials
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the Bedrock Agent Runtime client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in Bedrock.
